txn_codebook.A: Receipt of (i) interest, (ii) annuities, (iii) royalties, or (iv) rent

txn_codebook.C: Gift, grant, or capital contribution from related organization(s)
txn_codebook.D: Loans or loan guarantees to or for related organization(s)
txn_codebook.E: Loans or loan guarantees by related organization(s)
txn_codebook.G: Sale of assets to related organization(s)
txn_codebook.H: Purchase of assets from related organization(s)
txn_codebook.I: Exchange of assets with related organization(s)
txn_codebook.J: Lease of facilities, equipment, or other assets to related organization(s)
txn_codebook.K: Lease of facilities, equipment, or other assets from related organization(s)
txn_codebook.L: Performance of services or membership or fundraising solicitations for related organization(s)
txn_codebook.M: Performance of services or membership or fundraising solicitations by related organization(s)
txn_codebook.N: Sharing of facilities, equipment, mailing lists, or other assets with related organization(s)
txn_codebook.O: Sharing of paid employees with related organization(s)
txn_codebook.P: Reimbursement paid to related organization(s) for expenses
txn_codebook.Q: Reimbursement paid by related organization(s) for expenses
txn_codebook.R: Other transfer of cash or property to related organization(s)
txn_codebook.S: Other transfer of cash or property from related organization(s)

sched_r_v.method_note: Each transaction flows from the filer's foundation group, through its transaction-type code, to whether the related counterparty is §512(b)(13)-controlled. Width is either dollar volume or row count. Sankey only shows the four canonical foundation groups + 19 canonical transaction codes; the by_sector aggregates count those same rows.
